items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose naku-Aroni, wathi kubo:
Tshono ebantwaneni bakoIsrayeli uthi: Lezi ziyizilwane enizazidla phakathi kwezilwane zonke ezisemhlabeni.
Konke okudabula izinzipho nezinyawo eziqhekezayo, okwetshisayo phakathi kwezilwane, ningazidla.
Kepha kwezetshisayo aniyikuzidla nakwezidabula izinselo, njengekamela, ngokuba liyetshisa, lingadabuli izinselo zalo; ungcolile kini.
Nembila, ngokuba iyetshisa, kepha izinzipho azihlukani; ungcolile kini.
Nomvundla, ngokuba uyetshisa, kepha izinzipho awehlukani; ungcolile kini.
Nezingulube, nakuba zahlukanisile, zadabula izinselo, aziyetshisi; ungcolile kini.
Aniyikudla inyama yazo, ningathinti isidumbu sazo; zingcolile kini.
Lokhu lizakudla kukho konke okusemanzini: konke okulempiko lamaxolo emanzini, elwandle lemifuleni lizakudla.
Futhi zonke ezingenamaphiko nezingcwecwe, olwandle nasemifuleni, kukho konke okunwabuzelayo emanzini, nakuzo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ezisemanzini, kuyakuba yisinengiso kini.
Ziyakuba yisinengiso kini; aniyikuyidla inyama yazo, kepha izidumbu zazo ziyakuba yisinengiso kini.
Konke okungenamaphiko namaxolo emanzini kuyakuba yisinengiso kini.
Lezi yizo eniyakuba yisinengiso phakathi kwezinyoni; aziyikudliwa, ziyisinengiso: ukhozi, nenkawu, nenkawu,
namanqe nenkawu ngezinhlobo zabo;
negwababa ngezinhlobo zalo;
nesikhova, noklebe, noklebe ngezinhlobo zabo;
Nesikhova, nezikhova, nesikhova;
nedada, nevuba, nenqe,
nonogolantethe, nokhwalimanzi ngezinhlobo zabo, nezimpungushe, nelulwane.
Zonke izinyoni ezinwabuzelayo nezihamba ngezinyawo ezine ziyakuba yisinengiso kini.
Kodwa ningadla kuzo zonke izilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine, ezinemilenze phezu kwezinyawo zazo zokugxuma ngayo emhlabeni;
Nalezi kuzo ningazidla; isikhonyane ngezinhlobo zaso, nezinkumbi ngezinhlobo zazo, nezinkumbi ngezinhlobo zazo.
Kodwa zonke ezinye izilwanyana ezindizayo ezinezinyawo ezine ziyakuba yisinengiso kini.
Ngalokho niyakuba ngabangcolile: yilowo nalowo othinta isitengo saso uyakuba ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Noma ubani othwala noma iyiphi ingcuba yazo kumelwe ahlanze izingubo zakhe abe ongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Izidumbu zazo zonke izilwane ezidabula izinzipho zingadabulanga, zingatshisi, zingcolile kini; noma ubani oyithintayo uyakuba ngongcolile.
Konke okuhamba ngemilenze yakho kuzo zonke izilwane ezihamba ngezinyawo ezine, lezi zingcolile kini; othinta isidumbu sazo uyakuba ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Lowo othwala isithiyo sazo kumelwe ahlanze izingubo zakhe abe ongcolile kuze kuhlwe; zingcolile kini.
Lezi zingcolile kini phakathi kwezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni; inyoni, negundane, nofudu ngezinhlobo zalo;
inselele, nonwabu, noluka, nomnenke, nemvukuzane.
Ingcolile kini phakathi kwezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo; bonke abayithintayo isifile bayakuba ngabangcolile kuze kuhlwe.

Konke okuwela kukho enye yazo isifile, kuyakuba ngokungcolile; noma kuwukhuni, noma kuyingubo, noma kuyisikhumba, noma kuyisikhwama, noma kuyiyiphi into okusetshenzwa ngayo, iyakuphonswa emanzini, ibe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe; ngakho lizahlanjululwa.
Zonke izimbiza zebumba okuwela kuzo enye yazo, konke okuphakathi kwayo kuyakuba ngokungcolile; futhi uzoyiphula.
Yonke inyama edliwayo efika phezu kwamanzi anjalo iyakuba ngengcolile; lonke uphuzo oluphuzwa ngesitsha esinjalo luyakuba ngokungcolile.
Konke okuwela kukho isiyengo sazo kuyakuba ngokungcolile; kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iziko noma izimbiza zamabhodwe, kumelwe zibhodlozwe, ngoba zingcolile futhi ziyoba ezingcolile kini.
Kepha umthombo noma umthombo okukuwo amanzi amaningi kuyakuba kuhlanzekile; kepha othinta isidumbu sazo uyakuba ngongcolile.
Uma noma iyiphi ingcuba yazo iwela phezu kwembewu ezohlwanyelwa, kumelwe ihlanzeke.
Kodwa uma amanzi ethelwa phezu kwembewu, isidumbu sayo siwela phezu kwayo, ingcolile kini.
Uma kufa isilwane esidliwayo; othinta isidumbu sakhe uyakuba ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Odla ingcuba yayo kumelwe ahlanze izingubo zakhe abe ongcolile kuze kuhlwe; othwala iloyo uyakuhlanza izingubo zakhe, abe ngongcolile kuze kuhlwe.
Zonke izilo ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni ziyisinengiso; ingadliwa.
Konke okuhamba ngesisu, nakho konke okuhamba ngezinyawo ezine, nanoma yini enezinyawo eziningi phakathi kwezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni, aniyikuzidla; ngoba bayisinengiso.
Lingazenzi libe yisinengiso ngezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo, futhi lingazingcolisi ngayo ukuze ningcoliswe yiyo.
Ngokuba ngiyiNkosi uNkulunkulu wenu; ngakho-ke kufanele nibe ngcwele futhi nibe ngcwele ngokwenu; ngoba mina ngingcwele; aniyikuzingcolisa ngezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni.
Ngoba nginguJehova owalikhupha elizweni leGibhithe ukuze ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu; ngalokho nibe ngcwele, ngokuba mina ngingcwele.
Nanku umthetho wezilwane, nezinyoni, nezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emanzini, nezilwanyana ezinwabuzelayo emhlabeni:
ukuze enze umehluko phakathi kokungcolileyo nokuhlambulukileyo, naphakathi kwesilwane esidliwayo nesilwane esingadliwa.
